# fw heretic

> Reference of the fw heretic command: Heretic TOML preset inspector; `abliterate` runs directional orthogonalization on synthetic vectors. Usage, aliases and…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/heretic/

Heretic TOML preset inspector; `abliterate` runs directional orthogonalization on synthetic vectors

## Usage

```bash
fw heretic <presets|inspect|abliterate> [preset] [--strength 1.0]
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw heretic presets
fw heretic inspect
fw heretic abliterate
```

The names come from the usage line.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--strength` | `1.0` |

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
